newsitem.title: CANADA: Ontario plans to let retailers open Boxing Day.
newsitem.headline: Ontario plans to let retailers open Boxing Day.

text.p: The Ontario goverment said on Wednesday it planned to let retailers open for business on Boxing Day, the public holiday that falls on December 26.

The provincial government said it hoped the bill allowing the openings would be passed into law in time for Boxing Day this year. The legislation would also protect workers who refused to work on the day after Christmas.
In the past, some retailers who opened on the holiday faced heavy fines.
